//: EMULATOR-ONLY config (firestore + auth + FUNCTIONS). Kept SEPARATE from firebase.json on purpose: the deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy_19.yml) runs a bare `firebase deploy`, so a firestore/functions block in firebase.json would push to PRODUCTION (fir-sample-aae4a) — forbidden. Boot with: e2e/scripts/deploy-cf-emulator.sh  (which sets functions/package.json main -> index.emulator.js for the run, materializes functions/.secret.local, then runs `firebase emulators:start --project starlabs-cicd --config firebase.emulator.json`). The Firestore emulator partitions data by project id, so the seed, the Angular app, and the Flutter app must all use the SAME id (starlabs-cicd). functions.source resolves the `starlabs-cloud-function` symlink in the hub.
//databases: The Firestore emulator serves the DEFAULT db AND any named db (firestore-forms, firestore-atc) on demand — named DBs are created on first access, no per-db block needed here. firestore-atc (2026-10-13, operator rule): seeded and queried in the EMULATOR ONLY by the atc suite — never the development or production database. The app connects it in main.ts (emulator branch); index.emulator.js still excludes the ATC Cloud Functions. rules/indexes below apply to the default db. firestore-forms (2026-10-17): also emulator-connected by the app now — the profiles PA-13/14 + VPF, workshops WS-27 and queue cross-db Forms-widget emulator skips are removed.
//functions: source points at the nested CF repo (branch test/queue-e2e-deploy). NO `predeploy` loopDetector here — loopDetector.js runs against functions/index.js which `require`s the ATC module (getFirestore('firestore-atc') at module-eval); the emulator must load functions/index.emulator.js instead (the deploy script repoints package.json main). codebase id matches the cloud deploy for parity.
//firestore: rules/indexes apply to every database the emulator serves (the rules file matches /databases/{database}). CORRECTED 2026-10-17: the old note here said the emulator could not serve a named DB to the client ('multi-db unsupported → client reads DENY') — that was a misdiagnosis. Probed on firebase-tools 14.4 / emulator 1.19.8: unauthenticated client read+write to a named DB works and is isolated from (default). The real cause was the APP: src/main.ts connected only (default) to the emulator, so named-DB handles escaped to the real project. It now connects firestore-atc (2026-10-13) and firestore-forms (2026-10-17). Do NOT switch this block to the multi-db array form: the emulator still rejects that config shape.
//storage: Storage emulator (added 2026-10-13 for the atc suite media uploads: changework audio, note images, ATC images). Permissive EMULATOR-ONLY rules in storage.rules; the app connects via environment.emulator.ts emulators.storage.
